correctness.rationale: The six intrinsic triple points determine the smooth conic (another conic through five of them violates Bézout), and the nine lines through pairs of these points recover the connected K3,3 with its unique unordered bipartition. The inverse reconstruction is algebraic: on an ordered-line cover of this incidence stratum the concurrent triples are locally constant as incidence labels, their points are obtained by intersections, and the conic is the rank-five linear interpolation kernel. The subgroup H=(S3×S3)⋊C2 of S6 orders the same data on both sides; via the Veronese conic the common coarse quotient is the incidence-open subspace of M_{0,6}/H. For the double cover, 2W_i∼K, total ramification∼3K, and the theta characteristic of a triple is sum(W_i)−K, equal for the complementary triple. It is not effective: an effective degree-one theta is a Weierstrass point, but |K+W_i| consists of W_i plus a hyperelliptic fiber, never three distinct Weierstrass points. Distinct partitions can be oriented so the representative triples share two points, and equality of characteristics would imply equivalence of distinct degree-one points. This also verifies the classical dictionary using the six odd and sixteen total characteristics. Independent python3 /workspace/reproductions/1.py tests all 60 possible extra concurrences (any three chords concurrent off the conic must be a matching), obtains all ten admissible partitions and finds only the identity by cross-ratios. Nine chords and triple-point incidence then leave 36−18=18 double points. The open condition is nonempty, the normalized ordered configuration is irreducible of dimension three, and the index [S6:H]=10 applies on the dense open where all partitions are admitted and no nonidentity permutation fixes the normalized configuration. Ambient stabilizers correspond exactly to partition-preserving Möbius transformations, each with two hyperelliptic lifts differing by the involution. Dimca–Sticlaru Assumption 1.3 and Cor. 1.7 apply through an alternating Hamilton six-cycle and its opposite diagonals; the mdr and formality statements are prior. The witness does not prove a stack or boundary statement.

originality.rationale: The nine-line family and its conic syzygy condition, and separately the even-spin partition quotient, are prior work. The supported distinction is the algebraic recovery of the marking from the unlabelled arrangement and the resulting coarse-moduli comparison, including its geometric forgetful and stabilizer interpretations. No claim of historical uniqueness is made.
residual_risks: The incidence reconstruction might occur in older work under six-point invariant theory, Pascal/hexagon or configuration terminology. The bounded search is not a proof of priority.
The comparison to Ye is not a claim of whole-document noncoverage. Neither the audited statement nor the proof addresses degenerate conics, extra concurrences, or the moduli stacks.

value.rationale: This identifies a natural positive-dimensional Jacobian syzygy stratum of a standard incidence family with an open part of a familiar spin moduli space. It explains how to recover the intrinsic marking from the lines, how many projectively distinct arrangements lie over a general curve, and how to compute the projective symmetries via curve automorphisms. This is more than rechecking the prior syzygy example or giving an isolated witness.
